note: The SET of paths allowed to be dormant. check-test-set.mjs refuses any dormant entry absent here, so marking a running test dormant is a deliberate two-file diff (this file + tests.dormant.json), visible in review, and a new dormant entry fails by default. Removing a path from tests.dormant.json (wiring a test) needs no change here: this is a ceiling, not an exact match.
